description: **Call this at the start of any conversation about work, planning, or status — and any time the user asks about pending/open/in-progress tasks.** Shows pending tasks by default (sort by due date, urgent first). Use status "all" for everything, "resolved" for completed, "in_progress" for active work. IMPORTANT: Every task includes a dashboard URL (🔗). You MUST include these clickable links when presenting tasks to the user. If you see overdue tasks (past due date), surface them at the top of your response.

scope.description: "mine" shows only tasks assigned to or created by you (default), "all" shows all tasks in your organization/shared projects

name: tasks_list
